name: 15644 · Jeannette, PA
findings: ZIP 15644 (Jeannette) has 64 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15644 (Jeannette) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 15644 (Jeannette) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).
